system.description:
"Forged from glowing sea-glass and bound in silver wire, this spear hums with the tide of subterranean waters and the light of the moon."

Magic Shortspear — d6 damage (Versatile d8), Thrown 30 ft. Tailored for Princess Filly. 2 Gift Dice (house count — tune as desired).

Returning Current: when thrown it dissolves into water on impact and instantly reforms in Filly's hand.

Lunar Surge ([DICE]/[SUM]): modify the attack roll up to [SUM]; on a hit add [SUM] Cold/Water damage, plus [DICE]d4 Pack Hunt damage if the target is engaged with Tawny.

Tidal Wave Thrust ([DICE]/[SUM]): [DICE] creatures within a Stone's Throw take [SUM] Cold damage and make a GRACE test or are knocked prone and pushed.

Water Grace: spend Gift Dice to modify GRACE tests by [SUM] while swimming or climbing wet rock.

Recharge: submerge the tip in pristine natural water for a minute during a Picnic or Rest, or leave it in direct moonlight overnight.
